name: insurance_policies
description:
This attribute consolidates every insurance policy the Client mentions into a single list so cover gaps can be assessed. The two boolean adequacy judgements (term_insurance_coverage_adequacy, health_insurance_coverage_adequacy) stay as separate attributes. Return one item per distinct holding/instance mentioned. If the Client mentions a type only in aggregate, return one item for that type. Return an empty list when the group is not discussed. Return the list directly - there is no outer value/confidence wrapper.

Properties:
- insurance_type (enum, required): Type of policy, e.g. 'life_term', 'health'. Allowed values: life_term, health, ulip, other. Meanings: life_term = pure protection term cover; health = medical cover; ulip = Unit Linked Insurance Plan (investment-cum-insurance); other = any policy not listed.
- insurer (string, nullable): Insurance company, e.g. 'HDFC Life', 'Star Health'.
- policy_name (string, nullable): Plan name if given, e.g. 'Click 2 Protect'.
- covered_members (string, nullable): Who is covered, e.g. 'self', 'self, spouse, 2 children'.
- cover_amount (string, nullable): Sum assured / cover, e.g. 'INR 10000000'. Currency code or unit, one space, digits only - no commas, no symbols, no words: 'INR 1000000', 'USD 5400', '50 units', '0.5 BTC'. Convert lakh/crore to digits (10 lakh -> INR 1000000). '0' when the Client says they have none of this type. 'Yes' when the Client has it but gave no figure. null when not mentioned.
- premium_amount (string, nullable): Premium per period, e.g. 'INR 12000'. Currency code or unit, one space, digits only - no commas, no symbols, no words: 'INR 1000000', 'USD 5400', '50 units', '0.5 BTC'. Convert lakh/crore to digits (10 lakh -> INR 1000000). '0' when the Client says they have none of this type. 'Yes' when the Client has it but gave no figure. null when not mentioned.
- premium_frequency (enum, nullable): How often the premium is paid, e.g. 'annual'. Allowed values: monthly, quarterly, annual, one_time.
- source (enum, nullable): Who provides the cover, e.g. 'personal'. employer = group / corporate cover. Allowed values: employer, personal.
- confidence (number, required): How confident the model is in this item (0-1).
- confidence_type (enum, required): quoted = stated verbatim; normalized = stated but reformatted (e.g. '10 lakh' -> 'INR 1000000'); inferred = clearly implied; calculated = derived from several stated pieces; not_found = no value found for this type. Allowed values: quoted, normalized, inferred, calculated, not_found.
- evidence (string, nullable): Short verbatim quote(s) from the transcript supporting this item.

Examples:
Example 1 - Client: "I have a 1 crore HDFC term plan with 12k annual premium, and a 10 lakh Star Health family floater." -> [
  {
    "insurance_type": "life_term",
    "insurer": "HDFC Life",
    "policy_name": null,
    "covered_members": "self",
    "cover_amount": "INR 10000000",
    "premium_amount": "INR 12000",
    "premium_frequency": "annual",
    "source": "personal",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "1 crore HDFC term plan with 12k annual premium"
  },
  {
    "insurance_type": "health",
    "insurer": "Star Health",
    "policy_name": null,
    "covered_members": "family",
    "cover_amount": "INR 1000000",
    "premium_amount": null,
    "premium_frequency": null,
    "source": "personal",
    "confidence": 0.85,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "a 10 lakh Star Health family floater"
  }
]
Example 2 - Client: "My employer gives me a 5 lakh health cover for my family; I pay nothing for it." -> [
  {
    "insurance_type": "health",
    "insurer": null,
    "policy_name": null,
    "covered_members": "family",
    "cover_amount": "INR 500000",
    "premium_amount": "0",
    "premium_frequency": null,
    "source": "employer",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "My employer gives me a 5 lakh health cover for my family"
  }
]
Example 3 - Client: "I do have a ULIP from years ago but I don't remember the cover, and I have no separate term cover of my own." -> [
  {
    "insurance_type": "ulip",
    "insurer": null,
    "policy_name": null,
    "covered_members": null,
    "cover_amount": "Yes",
    "premium_amount": null,
    "premium_frequency": null,
    "source": "personal",
    "confidence": 0.75,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "I do have a ULIP from years ago but I don't remember the cover"
  },
  {
    "insurance_type": "life_term",
    "insurer": null,
    "policy_name": null,
    "covered_members": null,
    "cover_amount": "0",
    "premium_amount": null,
    "premium_frequency": null,
    "source": null,
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "I have no separate term cover of my own"
  }
]
